x: Bill Urry, as last year, gave a splendid show of even walking and finished tenth in 8 hr. 56 min. 58 sec. He was the first "Service" athlete to finish and, as last year, won the special prize.
Herring, Sid Spencer and Bill Urry, followed at an easier pace. Jack Bidgood eventually went away from the others and at the Chequers Horley was in ninth position.
Unfortunately Jack Baker and Gordon Doubleday were compelled to retire owing to foot trouble before the halfway stage was reached and later, at 40 miles, Bill Urry was forced to give up.
Gordon Doubleday, F.Herring, Sid Spencer and Bill Urry followed at an easier pace. Jack Bidgood eventually went away from the others and at Chequers Horley was in 9th position.
